status: Current-state fact sheet for PSPMAN 0.1.0-alpha.2 User's Guide

identity.creator: ObsoleteSony
identity.description: Walkman-inspired FLAC music player for Sony PSP, built with PocketJS.
identity.sourceAvailability: Private-source during active development; source code is not included with the Public Alpha

hardware.softwareRequirement: Custom firmware or another working homebrew environment

metadata.flac: Vorbis comments and embedded PICTURE front cover
metadata.display: UTF-8 metadata is preserved; some Japanese characters may not display correctly

artwork.behavior: Cover art may take longer to appear the first time; images that cannot be displayed show No Cover

library.startup: recursively scans enabled Memory Stick roots and reuses the persisted library index

about: SELECT opens the global About overlay; any button closes it
diagnostics: Pause playback, return to Library, then hold TRIANGLE to open Diagnostics
quit: HOME opens the PSP system confirmation; a confirmed exit completes PSPMAN's clean shutdown path
